name: Swiss Design
what_it_means: Also called the International Typographic Style (1950s Switzerland). It is built on a rigid modular grid, flush-left sans-serif type, asymmetric layouts and objective clarity. Big numbers, bold rules and red/black/white palettes make information feel engineered.
signature_moves: Visible modular grid and strong alignment
Asymmetric composition, huge type scale jumps
Red, black and white with geometric shapes
Numbers and labels used as graphic elements
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a homepage for [EVENT / STUDIO] in classic Swiss (International Typographic) style. Build on a visible 12-column grid with thin hairline rules. Use one grotesk typeface (Helvetica Neue or Inter) only, flush-left and ragged-right, with dramatic size contrast: a 140px bold headline next to 11px captions. Palette: white, black and signal red (#E30613) only. Add one large geometric shape (a red circle) placed asymmetrically. Use numbered sections (01, 02, 03) as graphic elements. No shadows, no rounded corners, no images except optional black-and-white photography.
